# Candidate Show HN post

Title: Show HN: Drop in a folder of HTML and get back a private URL
Project URL: https://eze.page/
Posted (UTC): 2026-10-20T23:45:03Z

## Project page text (fetch status: ok)

```text
Turn a folder into a private website for your team.
eze is open-source hosting you run inside your company. Upload some HTML and get a link that only your coworkers can open. Every site gets a database, live updates, file uploads and AI, with nothing to set up.
Set it up
GitHub
Self-hosted. MIT license.
lunch-vote
index.html
poll.js
style.css
eze deploy
lunch-vote.eze.acme.com
Where should we eat on Friday?
Ramen place on 5th
9
Tacos
4
Salad bar
1
AN
BO
CY
DE
4 people from Acme are voting
How it works
Make a site
Write plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript yourself, or ask your AI tool to.
Deploy it
Run
eze deploy
or drop the folder on the eze dashboard.
Share the link
Anyone signed in to your company can open it. Nobody else can.
A backend without a backend
Pages load one script from eze and can save data, react to changes and know who is looking. They use the viewer's company sign-in, so there are no keys in your code.
<script src="/_q/sdk.js"></script>
<script type="module">
const me = await eze.id.me();
const votes = eze.db.collection('votes');
await votes.create({ place: 'Ramen', by: me.name });
votes.subscribe({ onCreate: (vote) => redraw() });
</script>
eze.db
Save and query data, with live updates
eze.files
Uploads like images, video and PDFs
eze.ws
Rooms for cursors, chat and games
eze.ai
Call Claude, OpenAI or your own model
eze.id
The name and email of whoever is viewing
Works with your AI tools
eze init
adds instructions that teach coding agents how to build an eze site.
eze mcp
lets Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP apps deploy sites for you.
claude mcp add eze -- eze mcp
> make a site where my team can vote
on where to eat on Friday
Set it up
You need a server, a domain with wildcard DNS and HTTPS, and your company's sign-in: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra ID or any OpenID Connect provider, or an auth proxy you already use.
eze is one program with a small database file. A small VM is plenty.
Read the setup guide
go install github.com/ahyield/eze/cmd/eze@latest
EZE_DOMAIN=eze.acme.com \
EZE_AUTH=oidc \
EZE_OIDC_ISSUER=https://accounts.google.com \
EZE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=... \
EZE_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET=... \
EZE_OIDC_ALLOWED_DOMAINS=acme.com \
EZE_SESSION_SECRET=... \
eze serve
Only for your company
Everyone who can sign in can open, change and redeploy every site. That keeps eze simple, so keep it to your own people: eze won't start if its sign-in would let in a public email domain like gmail.com.
Found a security problem?
Report it privately
.
```

<think>Let me evaluate this candidate.

**Product:** eze - a self-hosted tool where you drop a folder of HTML/CSS/JS and get back a private URL for your team. It's "open-source hosting you run inside your company."

**Key features:**
- Self-hosted (run inside your company), MIT license.
- Upload a folder of HTML/CSS/JS (or drop folder on dashboard).
- Private URLs accessible only by coworkers (uses company sign-in: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra ID, OIDC).
- "A backend without a backend": pages load one script (`/_q/sdk.js`) and get:
  - Database with live updates (`eze.db`)
  - File uploads (`eze.files`)
  - WebSocket rooms (`eze.ws`)
  - AI via Claude/OpenAI (`eze.ai`)
  - User identity (`eze.id`)
- No keys in your code (uses viewer's company sign-in).
- Integrates with coding agents/MCP (`eze mcp` lets Claude Code/Cursor deploy sites).
- Single program with a small database file, small VM plenty.

**Why push:**
- Very clever idea: a "backend without a backend" for internal tools, where you just write plain HTML/CSS/JS and get DB + auth + AI + realtime, all self-hosted and private to your company.
- Very specific, useful vertical niche: internal team tools (voting, dashboards, tools) that need authentication and data but shouldn't be built as full web apps with custom backends.
- Fresh angle on internal tools: instead of low-code/MCP-builder, give developers a simple, powerful, self-hosted hosting primitive where auth/DB come for free via a script tag.
- Good example of what people are building now: bridging plain HTML with backend superpowers (auth/DB/AI) through a small self-hosted server and a client script.

**Decision:** push. It's a clever, self-contained product for internal tools.

Reasoning: The project "eze" is a clever "backend without a backend" for internal company tools—a self-hosted server where you just drop a folder of plain HTML and instantly get a private site with authentication, a database with live updates, file uploads, realtime WebSockets, AI calls, and user identity via a single script tag. Its fresh angle on building internal tools that don't need a dedicated backend, plus the MCP/AI-coding-agent integration, makes it an interesting and useful thing for the reader to see.</think>{"decision": "push", "reason": "这是一个很聪明的内部工具构思，它提供了一个“无需后端的后端”——你只需放一个包含 HTML/CSS/JS 的文件夹，就能立刻得到一个带身份验证、带实时更新的数据库、文件上传、实时 WebSocket、AI 调用以及用户身份识别的内部私有网站，全都通过一个简单的脚本标签实现，不用自己写后端代码。它以一种新鲜、实用且极其简洁的方式解决了“为公司内部编写小型工具”这个垂直需求，并且还做了 MCP/AI 编程代理的集成，是读者会觉得有趣并能从中受到启发的内容。" }
